First-time users must create an account by accessing the AU Service Desk. This works better on non-NIPR and Google Chrome. On the homepage under the Quick Links tab, select Official Transcript Request. Complete the required components of the form, add the attachments and submit.
The Service Desk can be accessed by any device that has internet access; it is Common Access Card (CAC) enabled, but this is not required.
The AU Service Desk is a secure application and certified for submission of Privacy Act information.

The Joint Services Transcript has replaced the Coast Guard Institute Transcript, the Army/American Council on Education Registry Transcript System, and the Sailor/Marine American Council on Education Registry Transcript.

facts.value: Students admitted to ASU under the Western Undergraduate Exchange, or WUE, program in spring 2026 or earlier will continue to receive the WUE tuition rate for the duration of their undergraduate program, provided they maintain continuous enrollment and meet renewal criteria.
https://admission.asu.edu/cost-aid/wue/maintaining-eligibility
A new scholarship designed for nonresident students to make an ASU degree more accessible to students nationwide.
Open to first-year out-of-state (not Arizona) U.S. citizens, regardless of their state of residency, campus choice, or major.
This is a renewable scholarship.
Available to students enrolled in any degree program on the Phoenix-area campuses, as well as the ASU California Center in Los Angeles.
Can be combined with the New American University Scholarship.
Transfer students are not eligible for the ASU Commitment Scholarship.
Must have a minimum 3.0 cumulative transfer GPA for scholarship consideration.
